implementation_notes: Node profiles with `--cpu-prof`/`--prof` and Chrome DevTools Performance panel for the browser. Measure allocation and GC explicitly; in V8, the shape of the code (monomorphic call sites, hidden classes, avoiding megamorphic dispatch) matters more than instruction counts.
idiom_name: V8 CPU profile + explicit GC/allocation measurement
code_sketch:
node --cpu-prof app.js
// browser: Performance panel -> record -> look for long tasks and GC pauses
pitfalls: Benchmarking with `console.time` around a function that the JIT inlines away
Micro-optimising before checking whether layout or network dominates
Transpiling away the very syntax being benchmarked
